items.title: Meta-Heuristic-EKF-Track-Building
items.subtitle: Helical EKF + meta-heuristics for TrackML reconstruction
items.summary: Fast, headless-safe TrackML reconstruction built on a helical EKF core with A*, ACO, GA, PSO, SA, and per-layer Hungarian branching; vectorized NumPy-first kernels, robust Cholesky gating, collaborative multithreading, and built-in hyperparameter optimization.

items.title: mkbench
items.subtitle: Docker-first mkFit benchmarking harness
items.summary: Reproducible build/run/compare workflow for mkFit variants with TrackML geometry artifacts, conversion tools, and automated performance + quality reporting (scaling sweeps, plots, JSON metrics).

items.title: VaR-Backtesting-Toolkit
items.subtitle: Kupiec + Christoffersen tests with Yahoo data + rolling VaR
items.summary: Command-line VaR backtesting script that pulls Yahoo Finance data (or reads a CSV), computes 1-day 99% historical and Gaussian VaR, flags exceptions, and runs Kupiec POF + Christoffersen independence tests with a combined conditional coverage report.
